title: Powers and duties of the director.
bodyText: The director may adopt rules in accordance with chapter 91 to carry out the functions, powers, and duties set forth in this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§446E-1.7]  Powers and duties of the director.  The director may adopt rules in accordance with chapter 91 to carry out the functions, powers, and duties set forth in this chapter. [L 1999, c 171, pt of §1]
